mapper.sql: person_id, view, scope, source_kind, source_ref, bg_scale, bg_dx, bg_dy
mapper.select: select from media_person_view where person_id in #{id} order by person_id asc, view asc, scope asc
select from media_person_view where person_id = #{personId} and view = #{view} and scope = #{scope} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into media_person_view (person_id, view, scope, source_kind, source_ref, bg_scale, bg_dx, bg_dy) values (#{personId}, #{view}, #{scope}, #{sourceKind}, #{sourceRef}, #{bgScale}, #{bgDx}, #{bgDy}) on duplicate key update source_kind = values(source_kind), source_ref = values(source_ref), bg_scale = values(bg_scale), bg_dx = values(bg_dx), bg_dy = values(bg_dy)
mapper.delete: delete from media_person_view where person_id = #{personId} and view = #{view} and scope = #{scope}
